facts.text: The resort sits between the Arabian Gulf, the terracotta desert and the Hajar Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Nestled between the Arabian Gulf, terracotta desert, and the Hajar Mountains

facts.text: The resort is about 45 minutes from Dubai.
facts.excerpt: is a five-star luxury UAE resort just 45 minutes from Dubai

facts.text: The resort offers private island living with white-sand beaches.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy private island living, pristine white-sand beaches

facts.text: Classic Sea View Rooms are designed with Arabian decor and have Gulf views.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully designed with elegant Arabian décor, each room offers a serene retreat with stunning Gulf views.

facts.text: Classic Sea View Rooms have a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Step onto your private balcony and breathe in the warm coastal breeze.

facts.text: Classic Sea View Rooms have smart-room technology.
facts.excerpt: sink into plush king or twin beds and enjoy sophisticated smart-room technology

facts.text: The resort has beachfront private pool villas and seafront villas set in gardens steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: Discover enchanting beachfront private pool villas and seafront villas amid our lush gardens, just steps from the white sandy beach.

facts.text: Each villa offers in-villa dining and room for family and friends.
facts.excerpt: Each villa offers beautiful living spaces, in-villa dining, and sophisticated amenities with ample room for family and friends.

facts.text: SPA InterContinental offers skincare treatments, body therapies and traditional hammam rituals.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in soothing skincare treatments, relaxing body therapies, and traditional Hammam rituals at SPA InterContinental

facts.text: Club InterContinental rooms are in a separate club building with their own check-in area, a club-only pool and food and beverage offerings throughout the day.
facts.excerpt: within the exclusive club building. With access to a separate check-in area, Club exclusive pool and exclusive food and beverage offerings throughout the day

facts.text: The Planet Trekkers Kids' Club runs activities focused on growth, curiosity and creativity.
facts.excerpt: activities are designed to inspire even the youngest travellers, with experiences focused on growth, curiosity, and creativity

facts.text: Levant & Nar has 360-degree sea views.
facts.excerpt: Savour creative cuisine and curated wines with 360-degree sea views at Levant & Nar

facts.text: Amarbar is a library-inspired bar with whiskeys and gins from around the world.
facts.excerpt: Step into a library inspired bar featuring whiskeys and gins sourced from around the world.

facts.text: ShaSha pool bar offers shisha and sunset views in the late afternoon.
facts.excerpt: Later in the afternoon, relax with shisha and take a front seat to a spectacular sunset show.

facts.text: Guests can try kayaking and stand-up paddling at the resort beach.
facts.excerpt: Head down to the resort beach to try kayaking and stand-up paddling

facts.text: Jet skis are available for rent at the beach.
facts.excerpt: Jet skis (for rent)

facts.text: Jebel Jais, the highest peak in the United Arab Emirates, can be explored from the resort.
facts.excerpt: explore the highest peak in the United Arab Emirates, 1,934m above sea

facts.text: Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is about 30 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: approximately 18.64 miles away (30 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: Kids eat free at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Kids eat free

facts.text: Pets are not allowed on the property.
facts.excerpt: We kindly ask guests to note that pets are not allowed on the property.

facts.text: Loaner bikes are available.
facts.excerpt: Loaner bikes
